project_name: SKh Pelita Al-Karomah - Sekolah Khusus Website & CMS Dashboard
target_audience: Parents of children with special needs (ABK), special education teachers, government/education inspectors, and school administrative staff in Indonesia

brand_identity.theme_type: Light Theme Priority (Warm, Trustworthy, Professional, Accessible, Family-Oriented)
brand_identity.primary_emotion: Empathetic, encouraging, clear, safe, and professional special-needs educational sanctuary
forbidden_styles: NO childish comic fonts (e.g. Comic Sans, Fredoka)
NO generic Inter/Roboto slop without character
NO cramped desktop-first tables that break on mobile smartphones
NO hidden desktop navigation links inside mobile-only hamburger

typography.heading_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif (Indonesian modern, warm, authoritative)

font_scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
font_scale.caption_label: text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase text-amber-700

text_size_toggle_strategy.normal_mode: Root class 'font-normal-mode' with standard base text 16px (1rem)
text_size_toggle_strategy.large_mode: Root class 'font-large-mode' scaling base text to 18px (1.125rem) with +2px boost across p, span, h1-h6, and button labels for parents with low vision or cognitive strain
text_size_toggle_strategy.ui_widget: Floating or top bar toggle buttons 'A' / 'A+' or 'Ukuran Teks: Normal | Besar' with active state highlighting (#EA580C bg)

accessibility_and_mobile_rules.minimum_touch_target: 44px height x 44px width minimum on all buttons, links, inputs, and tabs (py-3 px-4 minimum)
accessibility_and_mobile_rules.wcag_contrast: Text to background ratio >= 4.5:1 (Dark Charcoal #1C1917 on White/Orange bg with bold white text)
accessibility_and_mobile_rules.focus_states: Visible 3px solid focus ring (ring-2 ring-orange-500 ring-offset-2)
accessibility_and_mobile_rules.mobile_first_grid: All grid sections must be single column (grid-cols-1) on mobile screens (<640px) and expand smoothly to 2 or 3 columns on tablet (md) and desktop (lg)
accessibility_and_mobile_rules.testing_attribute: data-testid mandatory on all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='ppdb-submit-button', data-testid='text-size-toggle-large')

header.top_bar: Warm Orange (#EA580C) strip with quick contacts (WhatsApp, Telp, Jam Operasional, Text-Size Toggle)
header.main_navbar: Sticky header with backdrop blur (bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-stone-200 z-50). Visible nav items on desktop: Beranda, Profil, Program, Guru & Tendik, Berita, Galeri, PPDB, Kontak. Mobile hamburger menu drawer with clear 48px touch targets.
header.ppdb_cta: Prominent Orange Pill Button: 'Daftar PPDB Online' with yellow indicator dot or star badge

footer.content: School logo, brief mission statement, address map link, quick links, contacts (WhatsApp hotline), and accreditation badge (Terakreditasi B/A)

beranda: Hero Banner with student & teacher hero photo, school tag line 'Mendidik dengan Hati, Menumbuhkan Kemandirian Anak Spesial', PPDB CTA, and quick stats (Jumlah Siswa ABK, Terapi, Guru Pendamping Khusus)
Sambutan Kepala Sekolah with photo and warm personal message
Pilihan Program Cards (SDLB, SMPLB, SMALB, Program Kemandirian & Terapi)
Keunggulan Sekolah Bento Grid (Kurikulum Disesuaikan, Terapi Okupasi/Wicara, Ruang Sensori, Lingkungan Ramah ABK)
Testimoni Orang Tua (Warm quotes from parents)
profil: Tentang SKh Pelita Al-Karomah & Sejarah Singkat
Fasilitas Sekolah (Ruang Kelas Sensori, Ruang Terapi, Area Olahraga, Galeri Karya)
program: Program Keterampilan & Kemandirian (Tata Boga, Kerajinan Tangan, IT Dasar)
Layanan Terapi Khusus (Terapi Wicara, Terapi Okupasi, Bina Diri)
guru_and_tendik: Filterable grid of qualified special education teachers (GPK) and therapists with photo, full name, role, and specialization badges
berita_and_galeri: Berita & Artikel listing with search & category filter
Galeri Kegiatan image grid with lightbox view and filter tabs (Kegiatan Belajar, Terapi, Pentas Seni, Ekstrakulikuler)
ppdb: Multi-step / Multi-section PPDB Form (Data Calon Siswa, Kebutuhan Khusus/Diagnosa, Data Orang Tua, Unggah Dokumen / Kontak Rapid Register)
Alur Pendaftaran diagram & Syarat Pendaftaran checklist
kontak: Interactive WhatsApp Direct Chat button, Location map info, School operational hours, Contact form

admin_cms_dashboard.theme: Matches warm brand family (#FAFAF9 background, #1C1917 sidebar header with Orange active nav links)
key_modules: Overview Dashboard (Total Siswa, Pendaftar PPDB Baru, Jumlah Berita, Agenda Mendatang)
Kelola PPDB (Table with filter status 'Menunggu', 'Diterima', 'Wawancara', Export/Detail Modal)
CMS Berita & Agenda (Create/Edit/Delete articles with rich content input & image URL)
Kelola Galeri (Upload/Delete event images & assign categories)
Pengaturan Sekolah (Ubah Kontak, Sambutan Kepala Sekolah, Visi Misi)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the website language is entirely in Bahasa Indonesia (ID) with natural, respectful educational terms.
Implement the Text-Size Accessibility toggle in the top bar or floating header so clicking 'Besar' dynamically enlarges text across the page for better readability.
Ensure touch targets are at least 44px on mobile viewports for easy tapping by parents.
All forms (PPDB registration, contact form, CMS editors) must use clear validation, status toasts (Sonner), and accessible labels with data-testid attributes.

Do NOT use blue as primary buttons or background colors. Rely strictly on Orange (#EA580C) as primary, Yellow (#EAB308 / #FACC15) as secondary highlight, White/Cream for clean backgrounds, and Dark Charcoal (#1C1917) for legible typography.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and CMS controls MUST contain data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_dropdowns: Ensure headers, dropdown menus, and popovers have solid or heavy backdrop-blur backgrounds so text underneath does not bleed.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.mobile_first_execution: Always test mobile layout first. Cards should stack vertically, navigation should collapse cleanly into a mobile drawer, and tables in the admin dashboard should scroll horizontally or collapse into stacked cards on narrow screens.
